description: Who can move money from this currency or stablecoin to that one, in this country, over which rails? Paid ($0.03 USDC): Money-movement routes from one currency or stablecoin to another: corridors providers publish (rails, speed, fee notes, cited), plus on/off-ramp routes inferred from ramp coverage, labelled as inferred. This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://payments-intel-production.up.railway.app/v1/corridor. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL.

country.description: Destination ISO alpha-2 country, e.g. MX

from.description: Currency or stablecoin sent, e.g. USDC or USD

to.description: Currency or stablecoin received, e.g. MXN

name: find_corridor
